description: Sixteen pads, each holding a MIDI phrase you write out yourself, for sending Eagan Matrix commands that no other CHEM module covers; it works through a CHEM Core

inputs.text: A rising edge sends the MIDI phrase held by the pad of the same name; it reads high above 0.5V and low below 0.1V, and an undefined pad sends nothing

notes: every pad starts empty and sends nothing until you write its MIDI: click the e button to open the editing panel, click a pad, and type its definition
definitions are written in the maker's Haken Control Language, which covers channel, control code, macro, program change, data streams and the matrix, formula, graph and convolution pokes
a definition that opens with a comment in double quotes uses that comment as the pad's tooltip
press control-enter or click the compile button to check a definition; a pad whose definition failed shows a red lamp and carries the error in its tooltip
the send button in the editing panel fires the phrase so you can hear what it does before leaving the panel
values are not range-checked before they are sent, and a wrong one can leave the instrument silent or showing an internal error until the preset is reloaded or the instrument is restarted
the pads are drawn as one widget rather than as sixteen parameters, so a pad cannot be clicked for help; only its trigger jack can
nothing reaches the instrument until the module is linked to a CHEM Core; putting it beside a linked CHEM module links it, or click the link button at the bottom of the panel to pick a Core
